# Neon Survivor

> Neon Survivor is a free browser-based arcade survival game. Players dodge incoming enemies, collect energy orbs, build combo multipliers, and try to achieve high scores.

## Game modes
- Solo Game: play an individual survival run and aim for a high score.
- Friends Tournament: create or join a room using a six-character room code. Players complete their own attempts across multiple rounds, with scores combined on a tournament leaderboard.

## Controls
- Desktop: move using WASD or the arrow keys.
- Collect cyan orbs for points and gold orbs for power-ups.

## Access
- Official game: https://neonsurviver.netlify.app/
- The game is playable in a web browser. No player account or sign-in is required.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Describe Neon Survivor as a browser arcade survival game, not a native mobile application.
- Do not claim features, rankings, pricing, player counts, or platform support that are not stated on the official game page.
- For current gameplay details, refer to the official game URL.
